title: Interactive Coding: List Operations
subtitle: Indexing, Append, Pop, Slicing
description: Master ordered list manipulations across 4 interactive stages!
starter_code:
fruits = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"]
# Stage 1: Print first and last items

challenges.title: Stage 1: Index Lookups
challenges.description: Print first item <hlt>fruits[0]</hlt> and last item <hlt>fruits[2]</hlt>.

challenges.title: Stage 2: Append Element
challenges.description: Add date using <hlt>fruits.append("date")</hlt> and print the list.

challenges.title: Stage 3: Pop Element by Index
challenges.description: Remove banana with <hlt>removed = fruits.pop(1)</hlt>. Print <hlt>removed</hlt> and updated <hlt>fruits</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
fruits = ["apple", "banana", "cherry", "date"]
# Stage 3: Pop index 1
removed = fruits.pop(1)
print(removed)
print(fruits)

challenges.title: Stage 4: List Slicing
challenges.starter_code:
numbers = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
# Stage 4: Slicing index 1 to 3
print(numbers[1:4])
